title: Debug: the loop that skips and lies
prompt: Two bugs live in `firstEven(int[] values)`, which must return the index of the first even number or -1: it currently skips odd numbers at the wrong moment, and it uses `<=` at the boundary. Diagnose by reading, fix, verify with the tests.

tests.name: finds the first even
tests.hint: Odd numbers must be skipped with continue (or simply not break!).

tests.name: no even numbers
tests.hint: Without a match the seed -1 survives.

tests.name: empty array
tests.hint: The `<=` bound makes the original crash here — after the fix, no crash.
